ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Daycare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of alleged daycare fraud in Minnesota, including the involvement of taxpayer-funded group homes.

ideas.title: The Role of Somali Nonprofits in Minnesota's Welfare Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: Examine the allegations of Somali nonprofits being involved in Minnesota's welfare fraud scandal and the calls for deportations.

ideas.title: Governor Tim Walz's Response to Daycare Fraud Allegations
ideas.description: Analyze Governor Tim Walz's response to the daycare fraud allegations and the calls for his resignation.

ideas.title: The Medicaid Program Review: A Step Towards Preventing Future Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the extra review added to high-risk Medicaid programs in Minnesota and its potential impact on preventing future fraud.
